title: Licenses and call signs
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Today the FCC issues three license classes: Technician, General and Amateur Extra.
lines.label: three classes

lines.caption: After you pass, wait for the grant. Once it shows in the FCC license database, you may transmit.
lines.label: then you may transmit

lines.caption: The grant brings a call sign. A Technician can be given two letters, a digit and three letters.
lines.label: your call sign

lines.caption: The license lasts ten years. You may renew it starting ninety days before it ends.
lines.label: ten years

lines.caption: Miss the date and you have two years to renew. But no transmitting until you do.
lines.label: two years of grace

lines.caption: Now follow Doug's license, one step at a time.
